profile.name: 微型FPGA时序控制器
profile.description: 这是一种基于FPGA的实验时序与触发控制器，通常通过USB连接，用于显微成像和光学实验中的相机、激光器及其他外设同步。它可提供激光触发控制、相机触发时序、TTL/PWM/舵机输出以及模拟量输入采集，适合需要精确微秒级同步的实验系统。
profile.description_en: This is an FPGA-based laboratory timing and trigger controller, typically connected over USB, for synchronizing cameras, lasers, and other peripherals in microscopy and optical experiments. It provides laser trigger control, camera timing generation, TTL/PWM/servo outputs, and analog input readback, making it suitable for setups that require precise microsecond-level synchronization.
